(define-fun-rec python.join ((lst (List String)) (delim String)) String
    (ite (= lst (as nil (List String)))
         ""
         (ite (= (tail lst) (as nil (List String)))
              (head lst)
              (str.++ (head lst)
                     delim
                     (python.join (tail lst) delim)))))


(define-fun python.str.substr ((s String) (start Int) (end Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start))
        (end (ite (< end 0) (+ (str.len s) end) end)))
    (str.substr s start (- end start))))


(define-fun-rec str.count.rec ((s String) (sub String) (start Int)) Int
  (let ((idx (str.indexof s sub start)))
    (ite (or (= idx (- 1)) (> start (str.len s)))
         0
         (+ 1 (str.count.rec s sub (+ idx (str.len sub)))))))

(define-fun str.count ((s String) (sub String)) Int
  (ite (= (str.len sub) 0)
       (+ 1 (str.len s))
       (str.count.rec s sub 0)))

(define-fun list.adjust_index ((idx Int) (len Int)) Int

       (+ len idx)
       idx))

(define-fun-rec list.reverse.int ((l (List Int)) (acc (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (= l (as nil (List Int)))
       acc
       (list.reverse.int (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))


(define-fun list.valid_index.int ((l (List Int)) (idx Int)) Bool
  (and (>= idx 0) (< idx (list.length.int l))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.slice.int ((l (List Int)) (start Int) (stop Int) (step Int)) (List Int)
  (let ((len (list.length.int l)))
    (ite (= step 0)
         (as nil (List Int))
         (let ((adj_start (list.adjust_index start len))
               (adj_stop (list.adjust_index stop len)))

sat_func def sat(depths: List[int], parens="(()) ()()(()())() () ()(())() ()((()))"):
    groups = parens.split()
    for depth, group in zip(depths, groups):
        budget = depth

            if c == '(':
                budget -= 1

modified_func def sat(depths: List[int], parens=wrap_str('(()) ()()(()())() () ()(())() ()((()))')):

        group = _for_tmp_0[1]
        budget = depth
        success = False
        for c in group:
            if c == wrap_str('('):
                budget -= wrap_int(1)
                success = sym_ite(budget == wrap_int(0), True, success)
                _assert(budget >= wrap_int(0))
            else:
                _assert(c == wrap_str(')'))
                budget += wrap_int(1)
        _assert(success)
    return sym_len(groups) == sym_len(depths)

(declare-fun list.length.int ((List Int)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.int (as nil (List Int))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.int (cons h t) i) (list.get.int t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)

(declare-datatypes ((List 1))

(declare-fun list.length.string ((List String)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.string (as nil (List String))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h String) (t (List String)))
  (= (list.length.string (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.string t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List String)))
  (>= (list.length.string l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.string ((List String) Int) String)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h String) (t (List String)))
  (= (list.get.string (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h String) (t (List String)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.string (cons h t) i) (list.get.string t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List String)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)
      (= (list.get.string l i) (list.get.string l (+ (list.length.string l) i))))))

(set-logic ALL)

(declare-datatypes ((List 1))
    ((par (T) ((cons (head T) (tail (List T))) (nil)))))


(define-fun list.adjust_index ((idx Int) (len Int)) Int
  (ite (< idx 0)
       (+ len idx)
       idx))


(declare-fun list.length.int ((List Int)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.int (as nil (List Int))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.int (cons h t) i) (list.get.int t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)
      (= (list.get.int l i) (list.get.int l (+ (list.length.int l) i))))))


(define-fun-rec list.reverse.int ((l (List Int)) (acc (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (= l (as nil (List Int)))
       acc
       (list.reverse.int (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))


(define-fun list.valid_index.int ((l (List Int)) (idx Int)) Bool
  (and (>= idx 0) (< idx (list.length.int l))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.slice.int ((l (List Int)) (start Int) (stop Int) (step Int)) (List Int)
  (let ((len (list.length.int l)))
    (ite (= step 0)
         (as nil (List Int))
         (let ((adj_start (list.adjust_index start len))
               (adj_stop (list.adjust_index stop len)))
           (ite (> step 0)
                (list.reverse.int
                  (list.slice.int.helper l adj_start adj_stop step (as nil (List Int)))
                  (as nil (List Int)))
                (let ((real_start (- len 1 adj_start))
                      (real_stop (- len 1 adj_stop)))
                  (list.reverse.int
                    (list.slice.int.helper l real_start real_stop (ite (< step 0) (- 0 step) step) (as nil (List Int)))
                    (as nil (List Int)))))))))

(declare-const x (List Int))
(assert (= (list.slice.int x 0 -1 -1) (as nil (List Int))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.slice.int ((l (List Int)) (start Int) (stop Int) (step Int)) (List Int)
  (let ((len (list.length.int l)))
    (ite (= step 0)
         (as nil (List Int))
         (let ((adj_start (list.adjust_index start len))
               (adj_stop (list.adjust_index stop len)))
           (ite (> step 0)
                (list.reverse.int
                  (list.slice.int.helper l adj_start adj_stop step (as nil (List Int)))
                  (as nil (List Int)))
                (let ((real_start (- len 1 adj_start))
                      (real_stop (- len 1 adj_stop)))
                  (list.reverse.int
                    (list.slice.int.helper l real_start real_stop (ite (< step 0) (- 0 step) step) (as nil (List Int)))
                    (as nil (List Int)))))))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)

       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))

(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))
              (to_real (str-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)) base)))))))

(define-fun-rec bin-to-int ((s String)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (ite (<= len 0)
         0
         (+ (* (ite (= (str.substr s (- len 1) 1) "1") 1 0)
               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))
            (bin-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)))))))

       acc
       (list.reverse.int (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.slice.int ((l (List Int)) (start Int) (stop Int) (step Int)) (List Int)
  (let ((len (list.length.int l)))
    (ite (= step 0)
         (as nil (List Int))
         (let ((adj_start (list.adjust_index start len))
               (adj_stop (list.adjust_index stop len)))
           (ite (> step 0)
                (list.reverse.int
                  (list.slice.int.helper l adj_start adj_stop step (as nil (List Int)))
                  (as nil (List Int)))
                (let ((real_start (- len 1 adj_start))
                      (real_stop (- len 1 adj_stop)))
                  (list.reverse.int
                    (list.slice.int.helper l real_start real_stop (ite (< step 0) (- 0 step) step) (as nil (List Int)))
                    (as nil (List Int)))))))))

(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))
              (to_real (str-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)) base)))))))

(define-fun-rec bin-to-int ((s String)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (ite (<= len 0)
         0
         (+ (* (ite (= (str.substr s (- len 1) 1) "1") 1 0)
               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))
            (bin-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)))))))

(define-fun python.int.base10 ((s String)) Int
  (ite (and (str.prefixof "-" s) (> (str.len s) 1))
       (- (str.to_int (str.substr s 1 (- (str.len s) 1))))
       (str.to_int s)))

(define-fun python.int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (ite (= base 10) (python.int.base10 s) (ite (= base 2) (bin-to-int s) (str-to-int s base))))


(define-fun python.str.at ((s String) (start Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start)))
    (str.substr s start 1)))


(define-fun str.from_any_int ((x Int)) String
  (ite (< x 0)
       (str.++ "-" (str.from_int (- x)))
       (str.from_int x)))

(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))
              (to_real (str-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)) base)))))))

(define-fun-rec bin-to-int ((s String)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (ite (<= len 0)
         0
         (+ (* (ite (= (str.substr s (- len 1) 1) "1") 1 0)
               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))
            (bin-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)))))))

(define-fun python.int.base10 ((s String)) Int
  (ite (and (str.prefixof "-" s) (> (str.len s) 1))
       (- (str.to_int (str.substr s 1 (- (str.len s) 1))))
       (str.to_int s)))

(define-fun python.int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (ite (= base 10) (python.int.base10 s) (ite (= base 2) (bin-to-int s) (str-to-int s base))))


(define-fun python.str.at ((s String) (start Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start)))
    (str.substr s start 1)))


(define-fun str.from_any_int ((x Int)) String
  (ite (< x 0)
       (str.++ "-" (str.from_int (- x)))
       (str.from_int x)))


(declare-fun list.length.int ((List Int)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.int (as nil (List Int))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.int (cons h t) i) (list.get.int t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)
      (= (list.get.int l i) (list.get.int l (+ (list.length.int l) i))))))


(declare-fun list.count.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case

  (= (list.count.int (as nil (List Int)) val) 0)))
; Step case

  (= (list.count.int (cons h t) val)
     (+ (ite (= h val) 1 0) (list.count.int t val)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (val Int))
  (>= (list.count.int l val) 0)))

       idx))

       acc

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(declare-datatypes ((List 1))
    ((par (T) ((cons (head T) (tail (List T))) (nil)))))


(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))
              (to_real (str-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)) base)))))))

(define-fun-rec bin-to-int ((s String)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (ite (<= len 0)
         0
         (+ (* (ite (= (str.substr s (- len 1) 1) "1") 1 0)
               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))
            (bin-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)))))))

(define-fun python.int.base10 ((s String)) Int
  (ite (and (str.prefixof "-" s) (> (str.len s) 1))
       (- (str.to_int (str.substr s 1 (- (str.len s) 1))))
       (str.to_int s)))

(define-fun python.int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (ite (= base 10) (python.int.base10 s) (ite (= base 2) (bin-to-int s) (str-to-int s base))))


(define-fun python.str.at ((s String) (start Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start)))
    (str.substr s start 1)))


(define-fun str.from_any_int ((x Int)) String
  (ite (< x 0)
       (str.++ "-" (str.from_int (- x)))
       (str.from_int x)))


(declare-fun list.length.int ((List Int)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.int (as nil (List Int))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.int (cons h t) i) (list.get.int t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)
      (= (list.get.int l i) (list.get.int l (+ (list.length.int l) i))))))


(declare-fun list.count.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case
(assert (forall ((val Int))
  (= (list.count.int (as nil (List Int)) val) 0)))
; Step case
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (val Int))
  (= (list.count.int (cons h t) val)
     (+ (ite (= h val) 1 0) (list.count.int t val)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (val Int))
  (>= (list.count.int l val) 0)))


(define-fun list.contains.int ((l (List Int)) (val Int)) Bool
  (> (list.count.int l val) 0))


(define-fun list.adjust_index ((idx Int) (len Int)) Int
  (ite (< idx 0)
       (+ len idx)
       idx))


(define-fun-rec list.reverse.int ((l (List Int)) (acc (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (= l (as nil (List Int)))
       acc
       (list.reverse.int (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))


(define-fun list.valid_index.int ((l (List Int)) (idx Int)) Bool
  (and (>= idx 0) (< idx (list.length.int l))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.slice.int ((l (List Int)) (start Int) (stop Int) (step Int)) (List Int)
  (let ((len (list.length.int l)))
    (ite (= step 0)
         (as nil (List Int))
         (let ((adj_start (list.adjust_index start len))
               (adj_stop (list.adjust_index stop len)))
           (ite (> step 0)
                (list.reverse.int
                  (list.slice.int.helper l adj_start adj_stop step (as nil (List Int)))
                  (as nil (List Int)))
                (let ((real_start (- len 1 adj_start))
                      (real_stop (- len 1 adj_stop)))
                  (list.reverse.int
                    (list.slice.int.helper l real_start real_stop (ite (< step 0) (- 0 step) step) (as nil (List Int)))
                    (as nil (List Int)))))))))

(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))
              (to_real (str-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)) base)))))))

(define-fun-rec bin-to-int ((s String)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (ite (<= len 0)
         0
         (+ (* (ite (= (str.substr s (- len 1) 1) "1") 1 0)
               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))
            (bin-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)))))))

  (ite (and (str.prefixof "-" s) (> (str.len s) 1))
       (- (str.to_int (str.substr s 1 (- (str.len s) 1))))
       (str.to_int s)))

(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))
              (to_real (str-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)) base)))))))

(define-fun-rec bin-to-int ((s String)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (ite (<= len 0)
         0
         (+ (* (ite (= (str.substr s (- len 1) 1) "1") 1 0)
               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))
            (bin-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)))))))

(define-fun python.int.base10 ((s String)) Int
  (ite (and (str.prefixof "-" s) (> (str.len s) 1))
       (- (str.to_int (str.substr s 1 (- (str.len s) 1))))
       (str.to_int s)))

(define-fun python.int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (ite (= base 10) (python.int.base10 s) (ite (= base 2) (bin-to-int s) (str-to-int s base))))


(define-fun python.str.at ((s String) (start Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start)))
    (str.substr s start 1)))


(define-fun python.str.substr ((s String) (start Int) (end Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start))
        (end (ite (< end 0) (+ (str.len s) end) end)))
    (str.substr s start (- end start))))


(define-fun str.from_any_int ((x Int)) String
  (ite (< x 0)
       (str.++ "-" (str.from_int (- x)))
       (str.from_int x)))

(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))
              (to_real (str-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)) base)))))))

(define-fun-rec bin-to-int ((s String)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (ite (<= len 0)
         0
         (+ (* (ite (= (str.substr s (- len 1) 1) "1") 1 0)
               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))
            (bin-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)))))))

(define-fun python.int.base10 ((s String)) Int
  (ite (and (str.prefixof "-" s) (> (str.len s) 1))
       (- (str.to_int (str.substr s 1 (- (str.len s) 1))))
       (str.to_int s)))

(define-fun python.int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (ite (= base 10) (python.int.base10 s) (ite (= base 2) (bin-to-int s) (str-to-int s base))))


(define-fun python.str.at ((s String) (start Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start)))
    (str.substr s start 1)))


(define-fun python.str.substr ((s String) (start Int) (end Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start))
        (end (ite (< end 0) (+ (str.len s) end) end)))
    (str.substr s start (- end start))))


(define-fun str.from_any_int ((x Int)) String
  (ite (< x 0)
       (str.++ "-" (str.from_int (- x)))
       (str.from_int x)))


(declare-fun list.length.int ((List Int)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.int (as nil (List Int))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.int (cons h t) i) (list.get.int t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)
      (= (list.get.int l i) (list.get.int l (+ (list.length.int l) i))))))


(declare-fun list.append.int ((List Int) (List Int)) (List Int))

; Step case

  (= (list.append.int (cons h t) l2) (cons h (list.append.int t l2)))))

; Non-negativity

sat_func def sat(answers: List[str], lst=['234515', '21503', '2506236943']):
    if len(answers) != len(lst):
        return False
    for a, s in zip(answers, lst):
        if "t" in a:
            return False
        num_odds = sum(int(i) % 2 for i in s)
        if a.replace(str(num_odds), "t") != "this is a test":
            return False
    return True
modified_func def sat(answers: List[str], lst=wrap_list([wrap_str('234515'), wrap_str('21503'), wrap_str('2506236943')])):

        num_odds = sym_sum(sym_generator((sym_int(i) % wrap_int(2) for i in s)))
        if a.replace(sym_str(num_odds), wrap_str('t')) != wrap_str('this is a test'):
            return False
    return True

sat_func def sat(words: List[str], s="This is not a very hard puzzle", n=3):
    i = 0
    for w in s.split():
        num_consonants = 0
        for c in w.lower():
            if c not in "aeiou":
                num_consonants += 1
        if num_consonants == n:
            if words[i] != w:
                return False
            i += 1
    return i == len(words)
modified_func def sat(words: List[str], s=wrap_str('This is not a very hard puzzle'), n=wrap_int(3)):

        for c in w.lower():
            if sym_not(sym_in(c, wrap_str('aeiou'))):
                num_consonants += wrap_int(1)
        if num_consonants == n:
            if words[i] != w:
                return False
            i += wrap_int(1)
    return i == sym_len(words)

(define-fun-rec python.join ((lst (List String)) (delim String)) String
    (ite (= lst (as nil (List String)))
         ""
         (ite (= (tail lst) (as nil (List String)))
              (head lst)
              (str.++ (head lst)
                     delim
                     (python.join (tail lst) delim)))))

; Base case

; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)

  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))

sat_func def sat(valids: List[str], filenames=['cat.txt', '!jog.dll', '31F9.html', 'Is this okay?.txt', '.exe', '']):
    assert len(valids) == len(filenames)
    for v, f in zip(valids, filenames):
        n_digits = sum(c.isdigit() for c in f)
        if v == "Yes":
            prefix, ext = f.split(".")
            assert ext in ["txt", "dll", "exe"] and prefix[0].isalpha() and n_digits < 4
        else:
            assert v == "No"
            assert f.split(".")[1:] not in [['txt'], ['dll'], ['exe']] or not f[0].isalpha() or n_digits > 3
    return True

(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))
              (to_real (str-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)) base)))))))

(define-fun-rec bin-to-int ((s String)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (ite (<= len 0)
         0
         (+ (* (ite (= (str.substr s (- len 1) 1) "1") 1 0)
               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))
            (bin-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)))))))

(define-fun python.int.base10 ((s String)) Int
  (ite (and (str.prefixof "-" s) (> (str.len s) 1))
       (- (str.to_int (str.substr s 1 (- (str.len s) 1))))
       (str.to_int s)))

(define-fun python.int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (ite (= base 10) (python.int.base10 s) (ite (= base 2) (bin-to-int s) (str-to-int s base))))


(define-fun python.str.at ((s String) (start Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start)))
    (str.substr s start 1)))

  (ite (< x 0)
       (str.++ "-" (str.from_int (- x)))
       (str.from_int x)))

; Check if a single character is uppercase (A-Z)
(define-fun char.is_upper ((c String)) Bool
  (and (>= (str.to_code c) 65) (<= (str.to_code c) 90)))

; Check if a single character is lowercase (a-z)
(define-fun char.is_lower ((c String)) Bool
  (and (>= (str.to_code c) 97) (<= (str.to_code c) 122)))

; Convert uppercase char to lowercase
(define-fun char.to_lower ((c String)) String
  (str.from_code (+ (str.to_code c) 32)))

; Convert lowercase char to uppercase
(define-fun char.to_upper ((c String)) String
  (str.from_code (- (str.to_code c) 32)))


(define-fun swapcase_char ((c String)) String
  (ite (char.is_upper c)
       (char.to_lower c)
       (ite (char.is_lower c)
            (char.to_upper c)
            c)))

(define-fun-rec swapcase_helper ((i Int) (n Int) (s String)) String
  (ite (>= i n)
       ""
       (str.++ (swapcase_char (str.at s i))
               (swapcase_helper (+ i 1) n s))))

(define-fun swapcase ((s String)) String
  (swapcase_helper 0 (str.len s) s))


(define-fun-rec str.reverse ((s String)) String
  (ite (= s "")
       ""
       (str.++ (str.substr s (- (str.len s) 1) 1)
               (str.reverse (str.substr s 0 (- (str.len s) 1))))))

Solving puzzle 515/783: MinBigger:0
sat_func def sat(taken: List[int], val_counts=[[4, 3], [5, 2], [9, 3], [13, 13], [8, 11], [56, 1]], upper=11):
    advantage = 0
    assert len(taken) == len(val_counts) and sum(taken) <= upper
    for i, (val, count) in zip(taken, val_counts):
        assert 0 <= i <= count

; Base case

  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))

(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))
              (to_real (str-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)) base)))))))

(define-fun-rec bin-to-int ((s String)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (ite (<= len 0)
         0
         (+ (* (ite (= (str.substr s (- len 1) 1) "1") 1 0)
               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))
            (bin-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)))))))

(define-fun python.int.base10 ((s String)) Int
  (ite (and (str.prefixof "-" s) (> (str.len s) 1))
       (- (str.to_int (str.substr s 1 (- (str.len s) 1))))
       (str.to_int s)))

(define-fun python.int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (ite (= base 10) (python.int.base10 s) (ite (= base 2) (bin-to-int s) (str-to-int s base))))


(define-fun python.str.at ((s String) (start Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start)))
    (str.substr s start 1)))

(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))
              (to_real (str-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)) base)))))))

(define-fun-rec bin-to-int ((s String)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (ite (<= len 0)
         0
         (+ (* (ite (= (str.substr s (- len 1) 1) "1") 1 0)
               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))
            (bin-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)))))))

(define-fun python.int.base10 ((s String)) Int
  (ite (and (str.prefixof "-" s) (> (str.len s) 1))
       (- (str.to_int (str.substr s 1 (- (str.len s) 1))))
       (str.to_int s)))

(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))

               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))

      (= (list.get.string (cons h t) i) (list.get.string t (- i 1))))))

(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))
              (to_real (str-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)) base)))))))

(define-fun-rec bin-to-int ((s String)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (ite (<= len 0)
         0
         (+ (* (ite (= (str.substr s (- len 1) 1) "1") 1 0)
               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))
            (bin-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)))))))

(define-fun python.int.base10 ((s String)) Int
  (ite (and (str.prefixof "-" s) (> (str.len s) 1))
       (- (str.to_int (str.substr s 1 (- (str.len s) 1))))
       (str.to_int s)))

(define-fun python.int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (ite (= base 10) (python.int.base10 s) (ite (= base 2) (bin-to-int s) (str-to-int s base))))


(define-fun python.str.at ((s String) (start Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start)))
    (str.substr s start 1)))


(declare-fun list.length.string ((List String)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.string (as nil (List String))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h String) (t (List String)))
  (= (list.length.string (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.string t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List String)))
  (>= (list.length.string l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.string ((List String) Int) String)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h String) (t (List String)))
  (= (list.get.string (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h String) (t (List String)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.string (cons h t) i) (list.get.string t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List String)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)
      (= (list.get.string l i) (list.get.string l (+ (list.length.string l) i))))))


(declare-fun list.append.string ((List String) (List String)) (List String))
; Base case
(assert (forall ((l2 (List String)))
  (= (list.append.string (as nil (List String)) l2) l2)))
; Step case
(assert (forall ((h String) (t (List String)) (l2 (List String)))
  (= (list.append.string (cons h t) l2) (cons h (list.append.string t l2)))))


(define-fun list.adjust_index ((idx Int) (len Int)) Int
  (ite (< idx 0)
       (+ len idx)
       idx))


(define-fun-rec list.reverse.string ((l (List String)) (acc (List String))) (List String)
  (ite (= l (as nil (List String)))
       acc
       (list.reverse.string (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))


(define-fun list.valid_index.string ((l (List String)) (idx Int)) Bool
  (and (>= idx 0) (< idx (list.length.string l))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.string.helper ((l (List String)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List String))) (List String)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.string l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.string l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.string.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.slice.string ((l (List String)) (start Int) (stop Int) (step Int)) (List String)
  (let ((len (list.length.string l)))
    (ite (= step 0)
         (as nil (List String))
         (let ((adj_start (list.adjust_index start len))
               (adj_stop (list.adjust_index stop len)))
           (ite (> step 0)
                (list.reverse.string
                  (list.slice.string.helper l adj_start adj_stop step (as nil (List String)))
                  (as nil (List String)))
                (let ((real_start (- len 1 adj_start))
                      (real_stop (- len 1 adj_stop)))
                  (list.reverse.string
                    (list.slice.string.helper l real_start real_stop (ite (< step 0) (- 0 step) step) (as nil (List String)))
                    (as nil (List String)))))))))

(define-fun-rec str-to-int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (to_int
      (ite (<= len 0)
           0.0
           (+ (* (to_real (- (str.to_code (str.substr s (- len 1) 1)) 48))
                 (^ (to_real base) (to_real (- len 1))))
              (to_real (str-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)) base)))))))

(define-fun-rec bin-to-int ((s String)) Int
  (let ((len (str.len s)))
    (ite (<= len 0)
         0
         (+ (* (ite (= (str.substr s (- len 1) 1) "1") 1 0)
               (to_int (^ 2.0 (to_real (- len 1)))))
            (bin-to-int (str.substr s 0 (- len 1)))))))

(define-fun python.int.base10 ((s String)) Int
  (ite (and (str.prefixof "-" s) (> (str.len s) 1))
       (- (str.to_int (str.substr s 1 (- (str.len s) 1))))
       (str.to_int s)))

(define-fun python.int ((s String) (base Int)) Int
  (ite (= base 10) (python.int.base10 s) (ite (= base 2) (bin-to-int s) (str-to-int s base))))


(define-fun python.str.at ((s String) (start Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start)))
    (str.substr s start 1)))


(declare-fun list.length.string ((List String)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.string (as nil (List String))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h String) (t (List String)))
  (= (list.length.string (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.string t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List String)))
  (>= (list.length.string l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.string ((List String) Int) String)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h String) (t (List String)))
  (= (list.get.string (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h String) (t (List String)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.string (cons h t) i) (list.get.string t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List String)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)
      (= (list.get.string l i) (list.get.string l (+ (list.length.string l) i))))))


(declare-fun list.append.string ((List String) (List String)) (List String))
; Base case
(assert (forall ((l2 (List String)))
  (= (list.append.string (as nil (List String)) l2) l2)))
; Step case
(assert (forall ((h String) (t (List String)) (l2 (List String)))
  (= (list.append.string (cons h t) l2) (cons h (list.append.string t l2)))))


(define-fun list.adjust_index ((idx Int) (len Int)) Int
  (ite (< idx 0)
       (+ len idx)
       idx))


(define-fun-rec list.reverse.string ((l (List String)) (acc (List String))) (List String)
  (ite (= l (as nil (List String)))
       acc
       (list.reverse.string (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))


(define-fun list.valid_index.string ((l (List String)) (idx Int)) Bool
  (and (>= idx 0) (< idx (list.length.string l))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.string.helper ((l (List String)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List String))) (List String)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.string l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.string l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.string.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.slice.string ((l (List String)) (start Int) (stop Int) (step Int)) (List String)
  (let ((len (list.length.string l)))
    (ite (= step 0)
         (as nil (List String))
         (let ((adj_start (list.adjust_index start len))
               (adj_stop (list.adjust_index stop len)))
           (ite (> step 0)
                (list.reverse.string
                  (list.slice.string.helper l adj_start adj_stop step (as nil (List String)))
                  (as nil (List String)))
                (let ((real_start (- len 1 adj_start))
                      (real_stop (- len 1 adj_stop)))
                  (list.reverse.string
                    (list.slice.string.helper l real_start real_stop (ite (< step 0) (- 0 step) step) (as nil (List String)))
                    (as nil (List String)))))))))

(define-fun python.str.at ((s String) (start Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start)))
    (str.substr s start 1)))


(define-fun python.str.substr ((s String) (start Int) (end Int)) String
  (let ((start (ite (< start 0) (+ (str.len s) start) start))
        (end (ite (< end 0) (+ (str.len s) end) end)))
    (str.substr s start (- end start))))


(declare-fun list.length.int ((List Int)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.int (as nil (List Int))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.int (cons h t) i) (list.get.int t (- i 1))))))

sat_func def sat(transcripts: List[str], max_moves=10):
    COLORS = "ABCDEF"

    def helper(secret: str, transcript=""):
        if transcript.count("\n") == max_moves:
            return False
        guess = min([t for t in transcripts if t.startswith(transcript)], key=len)[-4:]
        if guess == secret:
            return True
        assert all(g in COLORS for g in guess)
        perfect = {c: sum([g == s == c for g, s in zip(guess, secret)]) for c in COLORS}
        almost = sum(min(guess.count(c), secret.count(c)) - perfect[c] for c in COLORS)
        return helper(secret, transcript + f"{guess} {sum(perfect.values())}{almost}\n")

    return all(helper(r + s + t + u) for r in COLORS for s in COLORS for t in COLORS for u in COLORS)

sat_func def sat(good_boards: List[str]):
    board_bit_reps = {tuple(sum(1 << i for i in range(9) if b[i] == c) for c in "XO") for b in good_boards}
    win = [any(i & w == w for w in [7, 56, 73, 84, 146, 273, 292, 448]) for i in range(512)]

    def tie(x, o):  # returns True if X has a forced tie/win assuming it's X's turn to move.
        x |= 1 << [i for i in range(9) if (x | (1 << i), o) in board_bit_reps][0]
        return not win[o] and (win[x] or all((x | o) & (1 << i) or tie(x, o | (1 << i)) for i in range(9)))

    return tie(0, 0)

sat_func def sat(good_boards: List[str]):

    win = [any(i & w == w for w in [7, 56, 73, 84, 146, 273, 292, 448]) for i in range(512)]

    def tie(x, o):  # returns True if O has a forced tie/win. It's O's turn to move.
        if o | x != 511:  # complete board
            o |= 1 << [i for i in range(9) if (x, o | (1 << i)) in board_bit_reps][0]
        return not win[x] and (win[o] or all((x | o) & (1 << i) or tie(x | (1 << i), o) for i in range(9)))

    return all(tie(1 << i, 0) for i in range(9))

(declare-fun list.length.int ((List Int)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.int (as nil (List Int))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)

  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))

(declare-fun list.length.int ((List Int)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.int (as nil (List Int))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.int (cons h t) i) (list.get.int t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)
      (= (list.get.int l i) (list.get.int l (+ (list.length.int l) i))))))


(declare-fun list.count.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case
(assert (forall ((val Int))
  (= (list.count.int (as nil (List Int)) val) 0)))
; Step case
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (val Int))
  (= (list.count.int (cons h t) val)
     (+ (ite (= h val) 1 0) (list.count.int t val)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (val Int))
  (>= (list.count.int l val) 0)))


(define-fun list.contains.int ((l (List Int)) (val Int)) Bool
  (> (list.count.int l val) 0))

  (ite (= l (as nil (List Int)))
       0
       (ite (list.contains.int (tail l) (head l))
            (list.set_len.int (tail l))
            (+ 1 (list.set_len.int (tail l))))))

; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)

  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))

  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))

  (ite (< idx 0)
       (+ len idx)
       idx))

  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))

         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(declare-fun list.length.int ((List Int)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.int (as nil (List Int))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.int (cons h t) i) (list.get.int t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)
      (= (list.get.int l i) (list.get.int l (+ (list.length.int l) i))))))


(define-fun list.adjust_index ((idx Int) (len Int)) Int
  (ite (< idx 0)
       (+ len idx)
       idx))


(define-fun-rec list.reverse.int ((l (List Int)) (acc (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (= l (as nil (List Int)))
       acc
       (list.reverse.int (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))


(define-fun list.valid_index.int ((l (List Int)) (idx Int)) Bool
  (and (>= idx 0) (< idx (list.length.int l))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.slice.int ((l (List Int)) (start Int) (stop Int) (step Int)) (List Int)
  (let ((len (list.length.int l)))
    (ite (= step 0)
         (as nil (List Int))
         (let ((adj_start (list.adjust_index start len))
               (adj_stop (list.adjust_index stop len)))
           (ite (> step 0)
                (list.reverse.int
                  (list.slice.int.helper l adj_start adj_stop step (as nil (List Int)))
                  (as nil (List Int)))
                (let ((real_start (- len 1 adj_start))
                      (real_stop (- len 1 adj_stop)))
                  (list.reverse.int
                    (list.slice.int.helper l real_start real_stop (ite (< step 0) (- 0 step) step) (as nil (List Int)))
                    (as nil (List Int)))))))))

(declare-const x (List Int))
(assert (> (list.length.int x) 0))
(assert (>= (list.length.int x) 1))
(assert (forall ((zip_pos_0 Int)) (=> (and (>= zip_pos_0 0) (< zip_pos_0 (list.length.int x))) (> (list.length.int x) zip_pos_0))))
(assert (forall ((zip_pos_0 Int)) (=> (and (>= zip_pos_0 0) (< zip_pos_0 (list.length.int x))) (> (list.length.int (list.slice.int x 1 -1 1)) zip_pos_0))))
(assert (forall ((zip_pos_0 Int)) (=> (and (>= zip_pos_0 0) (< zip_pos_0 (list.length.int x))) (and (and (= (list.get.int x 0) 14) (= (list.get.int x -1) 1)) (forall ((zip_pos_0 Int)) (=> (and (>= zip_pos_0 0) (< zip_pos_0 (list.length.int x))) false))))))
(assert (<= (list.length.int x) 4))

(define-fun list.adjust_index ((idx Int) (len Int)) Int
  (ite (< idx 0)
       (+ len idx)
       idx))


(define-fun-rec list.reverse.int ((l (List Int)) (acc (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (= l (as nil (List Int)))
       acc
       (list.reverse.int (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))


(define-fun list.valid_index.int ((l (List Int)) (idx Int)) Bool
  (and (>= idx 0) (< idx (list.length.int l))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.slice.int ((l (List Int)) (start Int) (stop Int) (step Int)) (List Int)
  (let ((len (list.length.int l)))
    (ite (= step 0)
         (as nil (List Int))
         (let ((adj_start (list.adjust_index start len))
               (adj_stop (list.adjust_index stop len)))
           (ite (> step 0)
                (list.reverse.int
                  (list.slice.int.helper l adj_start adj_stop step (as nil (List Int)))
                  (as nil (List Int)))
                (let ((real_start (- len 1 adj_start))
                      (real_stop (- len 1 adj_stop)))
                  (list.reverse.int
                    (list.slice.int.helper l real_start real_stop (ite (< step 0) (- 0 step) step) (as nil (List Int)))
                    (as nil (List Int)))))))))

(declare-const x (List Int))
(assert (> (list.length.int x) 0))
(assert (>= (list.length.int x) 1))
(assert (and (= (list.get.int x 0) 0) (= (list.get.int x -1) 7)))
(assert (forall ((zip_pos_0 Int)) (=> (and (>= zip_pos_0 0) (< zip_pos_0 (list.length.int x))) (> (list.length.int x) zip_pos_0))))

(declare-fun list.length.int ((List Int)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.int (as nil (List Int))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.int (cons h t) i) (list.get.int t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)
      (= (list.get.int l i) (list.get.int l (+ (list.length.int l) i))))))


(define-fun list.adjust_index ((idx Int) (len Int)) Int
  (ite (< idx 0)
       (+ len idx)
       idx))


(define-fun-rec list.reverse.int ((l (List Int)) (acc (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (= l (as nil (List Int)))
       acc
       (list.reverse.int (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))


(define-fun list.valid_index.int ((l (List Int)) (idx Int)) Bool
  (and (>= idx 0) (< idx (list.length.int l))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.slice.int ((l (List Int)) (start Int) (stop Int) (step Int)) (List Int)
  (let ((len (list.length.int l)))
    (ite (= step 0)
         (as nil (List Int))
         (let ((adj_start (list.adjust_index start len))
               (adj_stop (list.adjust_index stop len)))
           (ite (> step 0)
                (list.reverse.int
                  (list.slice.int.helper l adj_start adj_stop step (as nil (List Int)))
                  (as nil (List Int)))
                (let ((real_start (- len 1 adj_start))
                      (real_stop (- len 1 adj_stop)))
                  (list.reverse.int
                    (list.slice.int.helper l real_start real_stop (ite (< step 0) (- 0 step) step) (as nil (List Int)))
                    (as nil (List Int)))))))))

(assert false)

(declare-fun list.length.int ((List Int)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.int (as nil (List Int))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.count.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case
(assert (forall ((val Int))
  (= (list.count.int (as nil (List Int)) val) 0)))
; Step case
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (val Int))
  (= (list.count.int (cons h t) val)
     (+ (ite (= h val) 1 0) (list.count.int t val)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (val Int))
  (>= (list.count.int l val) 0)))


(define-fun list.contains.int ((l (List Int)) (val Int)) Bool
  (> (list.count.int l val) 0))


(define-fun-rec list.set_len.int ((l (List Int))) Int
  (ite (= l (as nil (List Int)))
       0
       (ite (list.contains.int (tail l) (head l))
            (list.set_len.int (tail l))
            (+ 1 (list.set_len.int (tail l))))))

(declare-fun list.get.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.int (cons h t) i) (list.get.int t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)
      (= (list.get.int l i) (list.get.int l (+ (list.length.int l) i))))))


(define-fun list.adjust_index ((idx Int) (len Int)) Int
  (ite (< idx 0)
       (+ len idx)
       idx))


(define-fun-rec list.reverse.int ((l (List Int)) (acc (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (= l (as nil (List Int)))
       acc
       (list.reverse.int (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))


(define-fun list.valid_index.int ((l (List Int)) (idx Int)) Bool
  (and (>= idx 0) (< idx (list.length.int l))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.slice.int ((l (List Int)) (start Int) (stop Int) (step Int)) (List Int)
  (let ((len (list.length.int l)))
    (ite (= step 0)
         (as nil (List Int))
         (let ((adj_start (list.adjust_index start len))
               (adj_stop (list.adjust_index stop len)))

                (list.reverse.int
                  (list.slice.int.helper l adj_start adj_stop step (as nil (List Int)))
                  (as nil (List Int)))

                      (real_stop (- len 1 adj_stop)))
                  (list.reverse.int
                    (list.slice.int.helper l real_start real_stop (ite (< step 0) (- 0 step) step) (as nil (List Int)))
                    (as nil (List Int)))))))))

(define-fun list.adjust_index ((idx Int) (len Int)) Int
  (ite (< idx 0)
       (+ len idx)
       idx))

  (ite (= l (as nil (List Int)))
       acc
       (list.reverse.int (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))

  (and (>= idx 0) (< idx (list.length.int l))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)

       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.adjust_index ((idx Int) (len Int)) Int
  (ite (< idx 0)
       (+ len idx)
       idx))

  (ite (= l (as nil (List Int)))
       acc
       (list.reverse.int (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))


(define-fun list.valid_index.int ((l (List Int)) (idx Int)) Bool
  (and (>= idx 0) (< idx (list.length.int l))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

    (ite (= step 0)

(declare-fun list.length.int ((List Int)) Int)
; Base case
(assert (= (list.length.int (as nil (List Int))) 0))
; Step case (Horn clause: premise => head)
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.length.int (cons h t)) (+ 1 (list.length.int t)))))
; Non-negativity
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)))
  (>= (list.length.int l) 0)))


(declare-fun list.get.int ((List Int) Int) Int)
; Base case: index 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)))
  (= (list.get.int (cons h t) 0) h)))
; Step case: index > 0
(assert (forall ((h Int) (t (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (> i 0)
      (= (list.get.int (cons h t) i) (list.get.int t (- i 1))))))
; Negative index
(assert (forall ((l (List Int)) (i Int))
  (=> (< i 0)
      (= (list.get.int l i) (list.get.int l (+ (list.length.int l) i))))))


(define-fun list.adjust_index ((idx Int) (len Int)) Int
  (ite (< idx 0)
       (+ len idx)
       idx))


(define-fun-rec list.reverse.int ((l (List Int)) (acc (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (= l (as nil (List Int)))
       acc
       (list.reverse.int (tail l) (cons (head l) acc))))


(define-fun list.valid_index.int ((l (List Int)) (idx Int)) Bool
  (and (>= idx 0) (< idx (list.length.int l))))

(define-fun-rec list.slice.int.helper ((l (List Int)) (curr Int) (stop Int) (step Int) (result (List Int))) (List Int)
  (ite (or (and (> step 0) (>= curr stop))
           (and (< step 0) (<= curr stop))
           (not (list.valid_index.int l curr)))
       result
       (let ((new_result (cons (list.get.int l curr) result)))
         (list.slice.int.helper l (+ curr step) stop step new_result))))

(define-fun list.slice.int ((l (List Int)) (start Int) (stop Int) (step Int)) (List Int)
  (let ((len (list.length.int l)))
    (ite (= step 0)
         (as nil (List Int))
         (let ((adj_start (list.adjust_index start len))
               (adj_stop (list.adjust_index stop len)))
           (ite (> step 0)
                (list.reverse.int
                  (list.slice.int.helper l adj_start adj_stop step (as nil (List Int)))
                  (as nil (List Int)))
                (let ((real_start (- len 1 adj_start))
                      (real_stop (- len 1 adj_stop)))
                  (list.reverse.int
                    (list.slice.int.helper l real_start real_stop (ite (< step 0) (- 0 step) step) (as nil (List Int)))
                    (as nil (List Int)))))))))

sat_func def sat(nums: List[int], b=7, m=6):
    assert len(nums) == len(set(nums)) == m and min(nums) >= 0

    def gcd(i, j):
        r, s = max(i, j), min(i, j)
        while s >= 1:
            r, s = s, (r % s)
        return r

    for a in nums:
        nums = [(a + i + 1) ** 2 + (a + i + 1) + 1 for i in range(b)]

    return True

sat_func def sat(counts: List[int], target_prob=0.5):
    m, n = counts  # m = num 1's, n = num -1's
    probs = [1.0] + [0.0] * n  # probs[n] is probability for current m, starting with m = 1
    for i in range(2, m + 1):  # compute probs using dynamic programming for m = i
        old_probs = probs
        probs = [1.0] + [0.0] * n
        for j in range(1, min(n + 1, i)):
            probs[j] = (
                    j / (i + j) * probs[j - 1]  # last element is a -1 so use probs
                    +
                    i / (i + j) * old_probs[j]  # last element is a 1 so use old_probs, m = i - 1
            )
    return abs(probs[n] - target_prob) < 1e-6
